purpose: Teach: 譴/發/ココログ/茲/兇/廚/李/眞

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、不正があった場合は譴責処分を厳格におこなえ
lines.en: If we find misconduct anywhere in this company, discipline must be applied without exception.
lines.style: Measured and formal. Steady eye contact. Each phrase lands with equal weight. No theatricality — pure authority through calm clarity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。旧字體の「發」の登記書類を保存します
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure all registration documents with the old character forms are properly archived.
lines.style: Respectful nod implied in the voice. Precise, slightly clipped — showing he's taking notes mentally. Competent without overselling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員ブログ、つまりココログ等のSNS規則を整えろ
lines.en: And I want our staff social media policy — blogs, services like Cocolog, all of it — standardized and tightened.
lines.style: Directive but not harsh. Slight pause between clauses to let each instruction settle. Assumes compliance without needing to demand it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。「茲に決定する」と形式に従って通知致します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll draft the formal notification following protocol and distribute it to all staff.
lines.style: Efficient, businesslike. The briefness shows he understands what's being asked. No extra words — respecting the boss's time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、工場での兇器持ち込み禁止を再徹底しろ
lines.en: Enforce the no-weapons policy at the factory again — make it crystal clear to everyone.
lines.style: Firmer tone. Not angry, but the weight behind 'enforce' and 'again' carries an edge. This matters beyond procedure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員食堂の廚房、つまり厨房の衛生検査を強化します
lines.en: Understood. I'll schedule a full hygiene inspection of the employee cafeteria kitchen and tighten standards across the board.
lines.style: Prompt, decisive. No filler. Shows he's already mentally running through the checklist. Calm but purposeful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の李部長を歓迎しろ
lines.en: I want everyone to extend a proper welcome to our new department head, Li.
lines.style: Shift to warmth — this is personal, not just procedural. Slight ease in tone. A reminder that leadership includes kindness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者の眞太郎様の社訓を社員に共有します
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure our founder Shintaro's philosophy and company principles are shared with the entire team.
lines.style: Respectful and reverent when naming the founder. Closes with quiet conviction — tying past to present. Composed finish.
